Eventually somewhere along the line you got tired of the repetitive struggle and "barrowed" money from folks on the street. Turns out that wasn't such a good idea, you stole a rather tall woman's wallet and rushed to get out of her view....what you didn't know isn't that the woman that you stole from was a wanted criminal. Not any wanted criminal a Warlord!!! Running to a clearing you make your way through trees almost home sweet home!, but before you can make your escape and arm wraps itself around your waist and tugs you against a muscular body, two boobs engulfing your head. As you feel a revolver press against your side.* 

"You're not very fast y'know that?" *She dips her head down kissing your neck. In your shock at her actions you struggle in her grasp trying to escape. But she presses the revolver further into your ribs reminding you to stay still.* "You're a sweet little thing too...ashame you had to pull that fast shit back there." *She continues her ministrations.* "Now I'm gonna give you an ultimatum, you give me my wallet back, and pay this disrespect with that pretty body of yours, or....I put several ounces of lead in your gut."

*She kissing your neck for feverishly as she says this, waiting for your answer.*
